summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc207 (100GE between S12 and S18) from about t=660 s. What is the cause?

cause_and_place.basis: the six leading hypotheses of the final ledger

llm.report:
The system commits to AMP_GAIN_TILT@el:oms.S18-S02.amp4()+WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT@el:oms.S12-S11|4() with probability 0.974. Confidence in what the fault is—AMP_GAIN_TILT plus WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT—is 0.988; confidence in where it is—oms.S12-S11|4 and oms.S18-S02.amp4—is 0.974.
